---
name: Component request
about: Request a new component or block for the registry
title: "[component] "
labels: component-request
---

## What component / block do you need?

Name and one-line description (e.g. "kanban-board — drag-and-drop task columns").

## Category

Which gallery category does it fit? (`ai`, `buttons`, `calendars`, `cards`, `charts`, `creative`, `feedback`, `forms`, `navigation`, `tables`, `account`, `ecommerce`, `auth`, `blog`, `dashboard`, `docs`)

## Design references

Screenshots, links, or examples of the look/behavior you have in mind.

## Must-have behavior

- Interactions (hover, drag, keyboard, …)
- Animation expectations (entrance, scroll, gesture)
- Data/props it should accept

## Would you use this in a real project?

Helps us prioritize — what are you building?
